name: Google Drive backfill sync
description: List files under root folder (depth 1 per run), upsert drive_files and drive_folders. Re-run while backfill_status=running.

steps.name: Split files and folders
steps.script:
local folder_mime = "application/vnd.google-apps.folder"
local files = {}
local folders = {}
for _, f in ipairs(steps.list_files.result.files or {}) do
  local row_base = {
    external_id = run.external_id,
    name = f.name,
    parent_ids = f.parents,
    trashed = f.trashed,
    synced_at = input.synced_at,
    source = "backfill",
  }
  if f.mime_type == folder_mime then
    table.insert(folders, {
      folder_id = f.id,
      name = f.name,
      parent_ids = f.parents,
      trashed = f.trashed,
      synced_at = input.synced_at,
      source = "backfill",
      external_id = run.external_id,
    })
  else
    table.insert(files, {
      file_id = f.id,
      name = f.name,
      mime_type = f.mime_type,
      parent_ids = f.parents,
      trashed = f.trashed,
      synced_at = input.synced_at,
      source = "backfill",
      external_id = run.external_id,
    })
  end
end
return { files = files, folders = folders }

for_each_body_steps.name: Map enriched file row
for_each_body_steps.script:
local f = steps.get_file.result
return {
  external_id = run.external_id,
  file_id = f.id,
  name = f.name,
  mime_type = f.mime_type,
  parent_ids = f.parents,
  trashed = f.trashed,
  size_bytes = f.size,
  web_view_link = f.web_view_link,
  web_content_link = f.web_content_link,
  created_time = f.created_time,
  modified_time = f.modified_time,
  synced_at = input.synced_at,
  source = "backfill",
}

steps.name: Mark backfill complete
steps.script:
local row = steps.read_sync_state.result.row or {}
return {
  external_id = run.external_id,
  connection_id = row.connection_id or input.connection_id or "",
  root_folder_id = row.root_folder_id or "root",
  backfill_status = "complete",
  backfill_folder_queue = row.backfill_folder_queue,
  backfill_after = row.backfill_after,
  last_sync_at = input.synced_at,
  poll_interval_seconds = row.poll_interval_seconds or 300,
}
